title: Destripe check
description: data of: depth.py SESSION --destripe-check --json. Whether the row-stripe correction (stacking.destripe) takes real light: stars of known brightness planted in a session's raw frames, before anything is done to them, measured with and without the correction.

found.description: Share of the planted stars the star finder picked up.

flux_ratio.description: Median of measured over planted flux; 1 is none lost.

flux_scatter.description: Spread of that ratio (1.4826 x median absolute deviation).

broad_light_changed.description: How much the correction changed the light in 64-pixel blocks, over how much that light varies across the frame; stripes removed count here too.
